extension.summary: Smooth Prime: Prime Video in the Aurora Cinema interface
extension.description: Smooth Prime is maintained by AgreeWithScotty. Native sign-in, account storage and authentication use independent Smooth Prime implementations. Remaining catalog/network/playback compatibility code is derived from Sandmann79/xbmc under GPL-3.0-or-later; see NOTICE.md. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Amazon account. Playback uses this add-on's existing player path and Kodi inputstream. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.news: 0.2.21[CR]- Start keyboard/remote focus on the In Progress top tab.[CR]- Fetch In Progress from Amazon on every visit and playback return; discard old saved and visible lists.[CR]- Remove locally saved playback-card merging and deduplicate repeated provider product identities.[CR]- Keep In Progress show/season progress fresh without local completion overrides.[CR]- Avoid reactivating the catalog window when Kodi already restored it, and remove catalog window fades.[CR]- Hide the entire add-on interface during native fullscreen playback.[CR]- Close the optional skip-scene dialog only when it is actually shown.[CR]- Preserve originating-card return, stock Kodi controls, native authentication and other sections' preloading.[CR]- Record fresh-list/cache cleanup, native window/view/focus/selection, timing and failure diagnostics.

extension.description: Delivers updates for the standalone Prime Scene add-on. The index is now hosted by ScottyWins.
